hints.title: Worker and Task Grouping
hints.text: Group tasks by skill requirement and sort profits descending so workers get top-paying tasks.

hints.title: Greedy Matching for Regular Workers
hints.text: Assign each regular worker with skill w the highest available profit task for that exact skill.

hints.title: Wildcard Special Worker Assignment
hints.text: The single special worker can take any leftover task across all skills. Greedily pick the maximum remaining profit across all groups.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

complexity.notes: Grouping and sorting task profits per skill takes O(m log m) time, and matching takes O(n).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Trying all possible task assignments across workers leads to exponential complexity.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Sorting tasks by skill requirement enables immediate greedy matching.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Apply greedy assignment using priority queues or sorted lists per skill category.
